India Reports First Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) Cases
For the first time, Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) has been detected in India, with two cases reported in Bengaluru:

#wistikles https://t.co/pJ1cY4hhuR

nodes.author: wistikles
nodes.text:
•Case 1: An 8-month-old boy, diagnosed on January 3, 2025, with bronchopneumonia, is recovering.
•Case 2: A 3-month-old girl was earlier diagnosed, treated, and discharged.
Both cases indicate local transmission, with no travel history.
#wistikles

nodes.author: wistikles
nodes.text:
What is HMPV?
HMPV affects young children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals, causing symptoms like fever, cough, cold-like issues, and respiratory distress.
#wistikles

nodes.author: wistikles
nodes.text:
Why It Matters:
•Most cases are mild and manageable.
•No unusual illness spike reported by authorities.
•HMPV is not new and closely monitored.
Stay Safe:
•Maintain good hygiene.
•Seek medical care for severe symptoms.

#wistikles
